verdict.rationale: Gram offers an in-dashboard agent harness to test MCP servers by chatting with a model that calls tools and inspecting logs 'before connecting a real client' (gram-docs-8), which implies some isolated testing capability, but no evidence explicitly describes a distinct sandbox environment or protections against touching production data/systems during testing. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment documentation, data isolation guarantees, or confirmation that test tool calls don't hit production APIs/data.
